scenicChapters.title: Basedow manor roads → Malchin lake view
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 10 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Atacama Altiplano Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 20 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
